FIVE DUCKS: five ducks paddling in a loose cluster near the pilings, small chevron ripples fanning out behind each one
FOUR GULLS: four gulls perched along the tops of the harbor posts, feathers ruffled against the breeze
CURLED CAT: a tabby cat tucked into a tight curl on a sun-warmed dock plank, tail wrapped around its paws
HERON STILL: one heron standing motionless in the ankle-deep shallows, a dark slender silhouette against the pale water
LONE FISHER: one small figure far down the dock, back turned, a rod arcing out over the grey water
DUCK CLUSTER: five ducks riding the gentle swell together, their reflections wobbling in the green harbor water
WHEELING GULLS: four gulls wheeling high and distant above the mast tips, white specks against the pale sky
DOCK CAT: a cat settled on the corner of a wooden crate, eyes half-closed, tail dangling over the edge
PATIENT HERON: a heron frozen mid-step in the shallows, one foot lifted, the reeds a soft blur behind it
DISTANT FISHER: a lone figure small against the far breakwater, leaning forward, rod tip low over the water
LANTERN LIGHTER: one small figure bent over the harbor post lamp, back toward us, a warm glow beginning at their hands
FISH RING: a single fish breaks the surface in a perfect spreading ring, gone before the ripple fades
PADDLING FIVE: five ducks weaving between the dock pilings in a ragged convoy, trailing thin white wakes
GULL ON POST: four gulls settled along a weathered breakwater rail, each one facing out toward open water
CRATE CAT: a grey cat curled tight atop a rope-wrapped crate at the dock edge, utterly still in the afternoon warmth
SHALLOW HERON: a heron stands alone in the glittering shallows, a thin vertical stroke in the wide flat water
FAR FISHER: a single small figure at the very end of the longest pier, rod held patient over the deep channel
WAITING DOG: a dog sitting at the dock's end, ears pricked toward the water, a still small shape in the fading light
LAMP TENDER: a small figure turned away, hands raised to a lantern on its post, an orange warmth spreading around them
SURFACE BREAK: one fish arcs just above the water and slips back, leaving a ring of rings across the dark harbor
DRIFT OF DUCKS: five ducks drifting slowly past the moored boats, their small forms reflected in the still gap between hulls
DISTANT GULLS: four gulls gliding far off over the outer harbor, banking together against the wide grey sky
DOCK HERON: a heron motionless at the shallow edge of the wharf, its long neck folded, waiting with great patience
DOCK DOG: a dog lies flat at the end of the dock, chin on the planks, looking out over the quiet water
LANTERN GLOW: a small figure standing at the foot of the harbor steps, back to us, lifting light into the dusk
